name: Bekasi Marathon 2026
short_description: Bekasi Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event held on August 9, 2026 in Kota Harapan Indah, Bekasi, Jawa Barat, Indonesia.
ai_summary: Bekasi Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event scheduled for August 9, 2026, in Kota Harapan Indah, Bekasi, Jawa Barat, Indonesia. Runners can choose from four distances: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, making it accessible to a range of runners from beginners to marathon veterans. Registration has been announced for this Indonesian road race.

research_highlights: Course loops through the Kota Harapan Indah residential/shophouse area, with cone-separated roads and tree-lined streets, compared by one runner to the feel of races in BSD.
Water stations are placed roughly every 2.5km along the route, according to a participant review.
Cut-off times are strict: Full Marathon 6 hours (flag off 04:00 WIB), Half Marathon 3h30m (05:00 WIB), 10K 2 hours (05:45 WIB), 5K 1h30m (06:00 WIB).

The venue is far from public transport — the nearest train station (Kranji) is about 9km away, and a TransJakarta route to the area only runs for the return trip, not the outbound journey, per a runner's account.
The 2025 edition (held in February, with 2,025 participants) was hit by rain at the start, whereas the August date typically brings hot weather to Bekasi according to runner comments.
research_watchouts: August races in Bekasi are reported as typically hot, which can be tough on a mostly flat, exposed course.
Getting to the venue without a car or motorbike is inconvenient; public transit options near Kota Harapan Indah are limited and the nearest station is roughly 9km away.
Cut-off times are described as strict, particularly for the Full Marathon, and were highlighted as the main challenge in the 2025 edition.

faqs.question: When is the Bekasi Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Bekasi Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 9, 2026. This date has been officially announced for the event, which will be hosted in Kota Harapan Indah, located in Bekasi, Jawa Barat, Indonesia.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at the Bekasi Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Bekasi Marathon 2026 offers four distance options for participants: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a 5km race, allowing runners of varying experience and fitness levels to participate.

faqs.question: Where is the Bekasi Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The Bekasi Marathon 2026 is held at Kota Harapan Indah, which is located in the city of Bekasi, in the Jawa Barat (West Java) province of Indonesia. This venue serves as the base for all race distances offered.
